verdict.rationale: Stripe documents a mandatory 'Treasury disclosure component' for compliance transparency (docs-12) and community discussion confirms partner-bank relationships (e.g., Goldman Sachs) exist and are scrutinized (comm-6), and the Evolve Bank breach thread shows real customer impact when a partner bank had problems (comm-1). However, there is no first-party documentation naming the specific sponsor bank(s), explaining FDIC pass-through insurance mechanics, or detailing what happens to end-customer funds if the platform or partner bank fails. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the sponsor-bank identity/relationship, FDIC insurance pass-through terms, and a documented failure/wind-down process for customer funds.
